children: Deep Fission announced a collaboration with Youngquist Brothers to evaluate and test large-diameter, deep-borehole drilling methods for its underground reactor deployment model.
Collaboration to evaluate and test drilling and borehole-construction methods supporting Deep Fission's underground reactor deployment model.
Completed Sept 3 demonstration: lowered and retrieved a 30-inch prototype canister into a 34-inch borehole to ~100 feet using Youngquist equipment.
Youngquist brings decades of large-diameter drilling experience, including boreholes exceeding 8,000 feet, to adapt commercial methods.
Work focuses on advancing installation, retrieval mechanics and full-depth drilling methods to support commercial deployment targeted as early as 2027.
